meta.subject: Fix tlb req cmd for DMA reads (#68)

en.summary: Fixes DMA read-side TLB requests so they present a read access type instead of incorrectly asking the translator to authorize them as writes.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly identifies a TLB request bug for DMA reads.
The only patch is in the DMA read translation request logic inside DUT code.
The corrected field is the memory-operation type used by translation and permission checks.
evidence: In StreamReaderCore, io.tlb.req.bits.tlb_req.cmd changes from M_XWR to M_XRD.
The surrounding logic is the read-side address-translation path for untranslated TileLink read requests.
The rest of the request stays the same, showing the bug was specifically the access-type code presented to the TLB.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Address-translation and protection logic commonly distinguishes load versus store permissions. A DMA engine that is fetching data from memory must therefore send a read-class translation request. If the hardware mislabels that request as a write, the TLB or permission checker can reject legal reads, take the wrong fault path, or apply the wrong access policy.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: access-type encoding on DMA read translation requests
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A DMA load or memory-read request goes through a translation or permission path that distinguishes read and write commands.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Encode the read-side translation request as a write access instead of a read access.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: swap the translation request command or permission class
portability_notes: This bug matters most on designs whose TLB, PMA, PMP, or page-permission logic checks access type.
If the design collapses read and write permissions together, the injected bug may be latent unless additional side effects depend on the command class.
The injection belongs on the translation request metadata, not on the downstream TileLink or AXI opcode.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the metadata field attached to DMA read requests when they are sent to the TLB or page-permission checker.
Change that field from the read or load code to the write or store code.
Leave the actual DMA dataflow as a read so the only mismatch is the translation-time permission class.
Do not modify the write-side path; the injected bug should only affect DMA reads.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: StreamReaderCore TLB request generation for DMA reads
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the TLB command field on read-side translation requests from M_XWR to M_XRD.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Set io.tlb.req.bits.tlb_req.cmd back to M_XWR in the StreamReaderCore translation request logic.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: DMA reads can spuriously fail permission checks, take the wrong translation fault path, or be blocked where only read access should have been required.
evidence_for_injection: The diff is a single-line change in the DMA read TLB request path.
The modified field is the translator command code, not the external memory opcode.
The commit title explicitly says the bug is on DMA reads, matching the StreamReaderCore location.
notes: This is a precise, highly portable permission-class mutation.
Use pages that are readable but not writable to make the failure mode obvious.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DMA 读路径的 TLB 请求类型，使其以“读访问”而不是错误的“写访问”身份进入地址翻译与权限检查逻辑。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出 DMA 读请求的 TLB 请求存在缺陷。
唯一的补丁位于 DUT 代码中的 DMA 读侧地址翻译请求逻辑。
修正的字段正是翻译与权限检查所使用的内存访问类型。
evidence: 在 StreamReaderCore 中，io.tlb.req.bits.tlb_req.cmd 从 M_XWR 改为 M_XRD。
周围代码正是未翻译 TileLink 读请求进入地址翻译的路径。
其余请求字段都未变化，说明缺陷点就是提交给 TLB 的访问类型编码。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 地址翻译与保护检查通常会区分读权限和写权限。DMA 引擎如果是在从内存读取数据，就必须发出“读”类翻译请求。若硬件把该请求错误标记为“写”，TLB 或权限检查器就可能错误地拒绝本来合法的读访问、走错 fault 路径，或应用错误的访问策略。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: DMA 读请求在地址翻译阶段的访问类型编码
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: DMA load/读请求经过会区分读写命令的地址翻译或权限检查路径。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把读侧翻译请求编码成写访问，而不是读访问。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 交换翻译请求上的命令或权限类别
portability_notes: 当设计中的 TLB、PMA、PMP 或页权限逻辑会检查访问类型时，这个缺陷最有意义。
如果设计把读写权限完全合并，该缺陷可能是潜伏的，除非还有其它逻辑依赖该命令类别。
注入位置应当在翻译请求的元数据上，而不是下游 TileLink 或 AXI 的外部操作码上。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 DMA 读请求进入 TLB 或页权限检查器时携带的访问类型字段。
把该字段从 read/load 编码改成 write/store 编码。
保持实际 DMA 数据流仍然是读操作，使失配只体现在翻译阶段的权限类别。
不要修改写路径；该缺陷应只影响 DMA 读操作。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DMA 读路径 StreamReaderCore 中的 TLB 请求生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把读路径翻译请求上的 TLB 命令字段从 M_XWR 改成了 M_XRD。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 StreamReaderCore 的翻译请求逻辑中，把 io.tlb.req.bits.tlb_req.cmd 改回 M_XWR。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: DMA 读操作可能错误地触发权限失败、进入错误的翻译 fault 路径，或在只需要读权限时被不当地阻塞。
evidence_for_injection: 整个 diff 只有读路径 TLB 请求中的一行改动。
被修改的是翻译器命令编码，而不是外部存储总线操作码。
提交标题明确指出问题发生在 DMA 读路径，与 StreamReaderCore 的位置完全一致。
notes: 这是一个非常精确、可移植性很高的权限类别变异。
使用“可读但不可写”的页最容易观察到错误行为。
